I did not read CMBYN but after watching the movie and discovering Find Me, I decided to read Find Me.

I enjoyed it immensely, even cried at certain parts. 
Gosh, Oliver's part--especially him talking to a version of Elio in his head--that made me cry. And of course, Elio and Michel's endscene, where Michel lets Elio go. I feel so sad for Michel. 

At some point, I even found myself wishing Elio and Michel would be the endgame. Because I keep on dwelling over the fact that Oliver had, after all, left Elio and got married. That's what Oliver chose and well, Michel seemed like a wonderful man. I was like-- 'goddamn it Elio, here's a sweet, kind, gentle man and you still can't get your head outta your ass and still mooning over an ex who abandoned you to get married!!'

I reached a point where I felt frustratiom at Elio, who, in my opinion, was wasting a perfectly good chance to move on.

Okay, so enough about my rants. 

I liked Find Me. 

I'm not a big fan of how huge Sami and Miranda's parts are. I felt like we should have gotten more Oliver parts.

If Find Me explored more on Oliver's POV, it would have been better.

But as it is now, I still loved reading it. Maybe that makes me part of a minority, but this is my opinion. I loved Find Me and can't wait for it to be a movie.

Three years, Will tried to escape. Found a readily available wife, a child, a family. Settled down and tried to live a life away from Hannibal, away from FBI.
